home.title: Panel
home.placeholderTitle: This will be your command centre.
home.placeholderBody: The dashboard is waiting for data. Until then, most of the action is in orders.

emailSettings.title: Email settings
emailSettings.intro: The sender of messages to customers and invitees, plus delivery status. The sending address is shared across the platform — you personalize the display name and reply-to address.
emailSettings.senderMissing: Sender: not set — rental lifecycle messages will not go out until a name is set.
emailSettings.nameLabel: Sender name (shown in the From field)
emailSettings.replyToHint: Customer replies go to this address. Without it, replies return to the platform address.

emailLog.title: Message history
emailLog.intro: A record of every send attempt: what reached the customer, and what did not — with the reason.
emailLog.emptyForOrder: No messages have been sent for this order yet.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.body: We sent you an email with a confirmation link. Click it to finish signing up and create your organization.

authError.emailRateLimit: We have already sent the maximum number of messages to this address. Please try again in an hour.
authError.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please try again in a moment.
authError.emailTaken: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in or reset your password.
authError.weakPassword: This password does not meet the security requirements. Use a longer one, with digits and special characters.
authError.linkExpired: This link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one.
authError.samePassword: The new password must be different from your current one.
authError.providerUnavailable: The sign-in service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
authError.generic: We could not complete this operation. Please try again in a moment.

security.title: Security
security.scanHint: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator) or enter the secret manually:

mfaChallenge.title: Confirm your identity
mfaChallenge.body: This section requires two-factor authentication. Enter the code from your authenticator app.
mfaChallenge.codeLabel: Code from your authenticator app (6 digits)

productForm.name: Name
productForm.moneyHint: Amount in major units, up to two decimal places, e.g. 100.50.
productForm.autoIncrementMultiplier: Daily multiplier beyond the highest tier
productForm.autoIncrementHint: Each day beyond the highest pricing tier costs base price × this multiplier. 1 = base price.

units.title: Units: {name}
units.empty: No units yet — the product cannot be handed out until it has at least one.
units.windowHint: Service window needs BOTH dates (from and to) or none. Same date on both = one-day service.

images.title: Photos: {name}
images.fileHint: Formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF. Up to 5 MB.
images.empty: No photos yet — add the first one to show this product in the store.

tiers.title: Pricing tiers: {name}
tiers.billingModelInfo: The shape of your tiers defines the billing model: a tier for every day means per-day billing, sparse tiers mean packages (e.g. “up to 7 days”). The preview below shows exactly what each rental length will cost.
tiers.emptyEditor: No tiers — every rental is billed at base price × number of days.
tiers.multiplierHint: The multiplier is the TOTAL price of the tier as a multiple of the daily base price — not a per-day multiplier. Days = 7, multiplier = 6.5, base 100 → the 7-day rental costs 650 in total. The tier price column shows the resulting amount.
tiers.previewIntro: Live calculation for each rental length, using the same pricing engine that will price orders.
tiers.previewSkippedRows: Rows skipped in the preview (incomplete or invalid): {count}.

emptyState.title: Empty warehouse. Add your first product.
Suspiciously quiet. Add your first order.

notFound.title: This page left without a handover protocol.

form.title: New order
form.noProducts: No active products — add a product in the catalog first.
form.previewTitle: Quote: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of rental
form.deliveryPricingMissing: Configure delivery pricing for this method in delivery settings before creating the order.

section.title: Delivery
section.pricingMissing: No delivery price list for this method.
section.notCourier: This order is not delivered by courier — shipments unavailable.
section.sendReturnLabelCta: Email the return label to the customer
section.returnLabelSentOk: Return label sent to the customer.
section.pickupReminderHint: Send the customer a reminder to return the equipment at the pickup location.
section.pickupReminderSentOk: Return reminder sent to the customer.
section.emailUnavailable: Email sending is unavailable — configure it to send messages.

settings.title: Delivery settings
settings.intro: Courier and delivery pricing configuration for this account.
settings.pricingIntro: Amounts in PLN. Empty price = method without pricing (creating a shipment reports a configuration error). Empty threshold = no free delivery.

detail.title: Order {number}
detail.cancelBlockedHint: Cancellation blocked — the payment must be settled (refunded) before cancelling.
detail.sendEmailUnavailable: Email sending is not configured — the customer will not be notified.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.empty: No deposit events yet — record a collection to open the settlement.

extension.title: Rental extension
extension.pickDateHint: Pick a date after the current rental end to see the surcharge.

site.title: Storefront page
site.subtitle: Arrange sections, pick a template and publish the page your customers see.
site.loadError: Could not load the storefront page. Refresh to try again.

sections.heading: Page sections
sections.addHint: pick a type to add a section
sections.empty: No sections yet. Add the first one to build your page.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.intro: This is the draft. Customers see it after you publish.

domainSettings.title: Store domains
domainSettings.intro: The addresses your store runs on. A subdomain on our domain is created automatically with your organisation. You can add your own domain below — it requires one DNS record at your registrar.
domainSettings.registrationUnavailable: Domain registration is unavailable — domains you add will not start working until the configuration is completed.
domainSettings.emptyState: You do not have a store address yet. A subdomain is created together with your organisation — if it is missing, create and register it below.
domainSettings.subdomainRegistered: Address registered — your store responds at it.
domainSettings.subdomainNotRegistered: This address is not registered with the hosting provider yet — your store will not respond at it. Retry the registration.
domainSettings.retryOk: Address registered — your store is live at it.
domainSettings.retryContactFallback: If it happens again on the next attempt, get in touch.
domainSettings.kindSubdomain: Platform subdomain — works immediately, no DNS setup needed.
domainSettings.kindCustom: Custom domain — works once the DNS record is confirmed.
domainSettings.dnsHeading: Record to add at your registrar
domainSettings.dnsIntro: Add this record in your domain's DNS panel. We cannot do this step for you — only you have access to your DNS.
domainSettings.dnsPropagation: DNS changes usually appear within minutes, sometimes hours. Then click “Check verification”.
domainSettings.verifiedOk: Domain verified — your store is live at this address.
domainSettings.stillPending: The domain is not verified yet.
domainSettings.domainHint: The host name only, without http:// and without a path.
domainSettings.addedOk: Domain added. Add the DNS record, then click “Check verification”.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Organization details shown on documents and in billing.
organization.name: Name
organization.readOnly: This screen is read-only. Avably support applies changes to organization data.
